_readme: The calibration deck's images and their tags. Attributes are known by
construction - every variant differs from its base in exactly one axis -
which is what makes a yes/no on a variant a clean signal about that axis.
Files are referenced relative to /calibration/. Generate with the command
in docs/calibration-images.md; the proof set is the chore-jacket group.
